analysis.summary: The frozen dossier records 15 rejected trials, all with the measured cause NEGATIVE_BEFORE_GAS: each had 10 paired observations, zero positive-gross observations, zero positive-known-net observations, and zero candidate signals. The reported best gross results were negative, so lowering an entry threshold or increasing persistence would not address the measured failure. Four asset clusters remain suspended; none is reopened by contradictory positive known-net measurements in this dossier. No hypotheses are proposed because availableCells is empty. The appropriate next action is to expand pool discovery, not to reuse a suspended cluster or treat an unmeasured route as a candidate.
